name: professor-exam-skills
description: Design complete exams, individual questions, marking guides, and equivalent variants at the depth the request needs.

interface.shortDescription: Create aligned exams, keys, rubrics, and equivalent variants without unnecessary process.
interface.longDescription: Two focused skills cover exam creation. make-exam is the default: it answers small requests directly and produces a compact exam package for full assessments. design-exam is optional for high-stakes work, approval-first design, complex variants, or formal alignment evidence. A shared exam specification connects question generation, equivalent variants, marking, and future AI grading, but quick requests are never forced through a large workflow. The bundle has no CLI, runtime dependencies, hooks, or mandatory research stage.
defaultPrompt: Create a 60-minute midterm from these course materials.
Write one application question with an answer key and rubric.
Design an exam blueprint for approval before writing questions.
